title: Fairy Morph
text: “The Love Hunter, root of all power, hereby commands. Read once more the truth of all creation, and return these persons to their original forms.”
“Anti-All Polymorph, I say!”
Fwoosh…! A spell designed to forcibly cancel transformation magic washes over us. But… nothing seems to change at all.
“It’s not Polymorph, it’s Fairy Morph, remember? Doesn’t that need a specific counter-spell?”
“Why not just try a simple status-ailment removal spell?”
“Ah, sure, let’s try that.”
So we all chanted the counter-spell together to try and return to our original forms, but no matter what, there was absolutely no sign of us changing back.
“Wait a second… don’t tell me we’re actually stuck like this?”
“N-no, calm down. We should be able to revert any moment now.”
“Ugh… what happens to us if we don’t!? Please tell me we’re not stuck like this forever!”
“Itsuki, hush for a second. You’re making me doubt your Hit-Rate ability now.”
“That’s right! If your mouth just spoke the truth, that would be no laughing matter!”
“R-right. Even if I want to say more, I’ll hold my tongue.”
Father and the others were gradually starting to panic.
“Motoyasu-kun. Have you experienced anything like this before, in any of the previous loops?”
“Unfortunately, I have no memory of it, I say. Though I do recall seeing Father experimenting by transforming animals once before… but it wasn’t into Peckul form.”
Was that the very first loop, I wonder? Or perhaps the loop where I was reunited with Fleon-chan? I seem to recall seeing something being cradled in Big Sister’s arms.
『Fufu, Naofumi-sama, it’s my turn this time.』
『Damn it! Stop being so fluffy!』
『You do this to me every single time, so please just bear with it!』
I believe that was indeed the loop where I reunited with Fleon-chan. But… back then, Father was definitely turned into a cat… wait— something suddenly throbs painfully in my head, I say.
“Motoyasu-kun? Are you all right?”
『Now that’s quite the amusing tale. Do I really resemble him that much?』
…! Who was that? That voice… I feel as though I’ve heard it somewhere, long, long ago.
“Are you really okay? Motoyasu-kun?”
“I-I’m fine, I say.”
“Guess we can’t rely on Motoyasu for this. The one we need at a time like this is—”
Just then, a knock echoed against the door.
“Rafu.”
“Um, Hero-sama, Sadeena-oneesan is—”
At that moment Big Sister opened the door with a Raph-species perched on her shoulder, walked in, took one look at us, and stopped mid-sentence.
“Ah, Raphtalia-chan, this is—”
Just as Father tried to explain the situation, Big Sister shut the door and bolted away without another word.
“Encountering an unfamiliar situation and immediately fleeing the scene. A perfectly appropriate response.”
In this loop, Big Sister is still young, after all. Since we’ve been teaching her to rely on the adults around her whenever something dangerous happens, I suppose that reaction was quite correct.
“Well… I think we can call that a proper response from Raphtalia-chan, more or less… Anyway, let’s get out of here and go ask Sadeena-san or Gaelion-chan.”
“Agreed. This situation is far too much for the two of us to handle alone. Let’s go.”
“Right, we can’t stay like this forever.”
“Then let us depart, I say.”
My legs feel remarkably light. I kicked the door open with a twist, and together we all headed outside.
“Er, um, everyone’s…”
As Father stepped outside and looked around, Big Sister promptly returned, bringing Older Sister along with her.
“Ohh~”
“Right here, Sadeena-oneesan.”
“Ah, Sadeena-san! Thank you, Raphtalia-chan, for bringing her here.”
Big Sister nodded at Father’s words.
“Ohh, ohh, ohh~”
Older Sister looked us over and approached with her usual air of nonchalance.
“Sadeena-san, I know I look like this, but it’s me, Naofumi Iwatani. You might be surprised, but it seems some magic turned me into a Peckul, and I don’t know how to undo it—”
“Ohh~”
Older Sister stepped forward and scooped up Father, mid-explanation, into her arms.
“Sadeena-san? Are you listening? Wait, why are you just carrying me off like this? Motoyasu-kun, Ren, and Itsuki are right there too, y’know. Let’s ask someone who actually knows what they’re doing—”
Without pause, Older Sister carried Father clean away.
“Sadeena-san? Sadeenaaa-saaaan——!”
That exact motion—it was identical, down to the last detail, to how Father once acted when Big Sister had turned into a Raph-species.
“Uhh… um.”
“Rafu.”
Big Sister glanced back and forth between us and Father being carried off, then chased after Older Sister.
“What in the world was that about? Are we supposed to assume she just… granted Naofumi’s request and carried him off?”
“That exact motion Older Sister made—it was identical to the time Father carried off Big Sister after she’d turned into a monster form he liked, I say.”
“So she found a creature she liked, caught it, and took it home, is that it?”
“…Everyone, do you know what the natural enemy of a penguin is?”
Here, Itsuki muttered out of nowhere.
“Apparently, it’s an orca.”
“Father!?”
“Naofumi!”
The instant we all lunged to chase after Father—
“Ah.”
That’s when Mole and, trailing behind her, Luna-chan noticed us.
“Um…”

“Imiya, perfect timing! I’m Ren Amaki—I know I look like this now because a spell backfired, but that’s not important. Naofumi got turned into a Peckul and Sadeena just hauled him off without so much as a by-your-leave—”

Mole took one look at our weapons and seemed to piece together the situation as she approached, but suddenly a chill ran down my spine—some presence, distinct from any ordinary bloodlust, sent goosebumps crawling up my skin. It felt as though some famished monster were watching us. Th-this presence… hiiii… it’s eerily similar to Filo-tan’s aura from back then, I saaaaay!?
“Hiiiiii…”
“Motoyasu-san?”
With a heavy, ominous weight, Luna-chan stepped in front of Mole as if to block her path, and turned her gaze toward Ren.
“…Cute.”

I recognize that look in her eyes. That’s the exact same look Luna-chan gave when she first laid eyes on Keel. And right now, Ren happens to bear a striking resemblance to Inult… to Keel, in fact. In this loop, we haven’t managed to find Keel yet, so Luna-chan had been satisfying that particular craving by doting on Mole instead. Of course, she’d been showering Mole with affection all this while—but what happens when a creature that hits even closer to her strike zone suddenly appears?
“H-hey. Luna? What are you planning to do!? Whoa!”
Luna-chan scooped Ren right up and began trying to bury him within her lush plumage. It was the very picture of winter-time Keel, unmistakably.
“Whoa! I’m being swallowed by feathers— Itsuki, Motoyasu, help— K-Kuro! Rafumi! Rafumi!”

While Ren struggled valiantly against her, Luna-chan turned her gaze toward Itsuki and me next. A shiver ran through me too, and all I could think of was fleeing, I say! Ren’s cry for help had sounded utterly, terrifyingly genuine, after all! Hiiii… Filo-tan! Please forgive me, I saaay!
“What’s wrong, Azott?”
That’s when Rafumi appeared.
“Perfect timing! Luna’s attacking me! I can’t let her hurt herself by accident, so help me out here!”
“Hmm… Azott, Rafumi fully supports Azott’s romance. The other party seems quite enthusiastic as well. Go on and get along nicely.”
Rafumi declared this with absolute conviction, then settled comfortably into the role of bystander.
“D-don’t mess around! Just hurry up and help me already! This is completely different from ‘lacking a romantic connection,’ isn’t it!?”

“Rafumi is the envoy of a future that wishes for Azott’s healthy and happy days ahead. If this connection leads to a joyous Christmas of happiness for Azott, then it is Rafumi’s duty to gladly watch it unfold.”
“Rafumi-san, you really are a hopeless case, aren’t you…”
Ren’s furious outburst and Itsuki’s exasperated sigh made quite the impression—but more than that, I found myself utterly frozen, paralyzed with terror by the aura radiating off of Luna-chan.
